name: Zeus
body:
ZEUS
CR 30

XP 6,881,200
N Medium outsider (god)
Init + 5; Senses blindsight 500 ft., darkvision 60 ft., true seeing; Perception +43

DEFENSE

AC 53, touch 34, flat-footed 48 (+19 armor,+5 Dexterity, +19 deflection)
hp 1,080 (40d10 +680); fast healing 200
Fort +50, Ref +29, Will + 33; DR 20/-; SR 41

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +9 legendary keen exsanguinating lacerating shocking burst throwing longsword+61 (2d8+25+2d6 electric/17-20)
Special Attacks deific might
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 30th)
Domain Spells

9th–storm of vengeance (DC 43)
8th–demand, whirlwind (DC 42)
7th–control weather, repulsion (DC 41)
6th–control winds, geas/quest (DC 40)
5th-greater command, ice storm (DC 39)
4th–discern lies, sleet storm (DC 38)
3rd–call lightning, magic vestment (DC 37)
2nd–enthrall, fog cloud (DC 36)
1st–divine favor, obscuring mist (DC 35)
20/day–summon (any creatures, combined CR of 30 or less)

STATISTICS

Str 34, Dex 20, Con 42, Int 24, Wis 38, Cha 42
Base Atk +40; CMB +52; CMD +57
Feats Alertness, Cleave, Combat Casting, Combat Expertise, Critical Focus, Deific Casting, Divine Spark, Greater Vital Strike, Great Fortitude, Improved Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Improved Iron Will, Improved Lightning Reflexes, Improved Vital Strike, Iron Will, Legendary Magic, Legendary Vital Strike, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Vital Strike
Skills Acrobatics +45, Bluff +59, Craft (calligraphy) +50, Diplomacy +59, Fly +48, Intimidate +56, Knowledge (nobility) +50, Knowledge (planes) +50, Knowledge (religion) +50, Perception +43, Sense Motive +43, Spellcraft +50, Stealth +48
SQ Deific Traits [Demesne (Mt. Olympus), Immortal Constitution, Lord of Storm and Skies, Shape Shifter]
Deific Weaknesses: Fabled Flaw (Wisdom)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Aligned Strike (Su)

A deity’s natural weapons, as well as any weapons it wields, are treated as being aligned to both sides of the deity’s alignment and as being epic for the purpose of resolving damage reduction.

Domain Mastery (Sp)

Zeus possesses the Weather and Nobility domains. He may use any domain powers and cast any spells associated with his domains at-will. Zeus counts as a 30th level cleric for the purposes of domain powers and caster level. The DCs of these spells are Wisdom based.

Provide Power (Su)

Zeus stands at the head of his pantheon. As a full-round action, Zeus may transfer up to 10 points of divine rank from any creature that recognizes him as the head of their pantheon to another creature. Many heads of pantheons use this ability to allow deities to pull off more impressive tasks than are normally possible even for themselves. Others, however, simply demand some of the divine power possessed by others as tribute to their own deific might. Such behavior has been the source of revolution within the heavens on more than one occasion.

Reshape the World (Sp)

Zeus calls all the loyal gods within his pantheon to accomplish some great deed or to dramatically alter some aspect of the world. By setting all deities under his authority to work on this task over the course of a full day, Zeus may cast the unlimited wish true dweomer as a spell-like ability. Using this ability does not require the use of material components.

Deific Might (Sp)

As a swift action, Zeus may change his size to any size category of his choice and may increase all of his ability scores by a number equal to his divinity score. These adjustments last for one hour or until Zeus dismisses them as a free action. All Zeus’s attacks while in this state deal L-damage that may be resisted with a DC 44 Fortitude save.

Semi-Unlimited Wish (Sp)

The deity may cast unlimited wish once per day as a spell-like ability that does not require material components. The unlimited wish may only be in regards to something within the deity’s purview. A god of oceans could cause global draught or flooding, for instance, but could not produce any effect unrelated to oceans.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure triple standard, +10 glamered legendary celestial chainmail of heavy fortification, +9 legendary keen exsanguinating lacerating shocking burst throwing longsword

Deities are powerful. Through their raw strength, they can topple kingdoms. Through their sway over elemental forces of the world, they can move stars, command seas, and forge new forms of life. Among the deities, however, there are those who possess not only the powers inherent to the divine but all the secrets of the arcane as well. Such deities know the mysterious magic that wizards kill demon lords to learn scraps of. Every spell written has been mastered by such deities, and half of those spells were written by such deities themselves. The magical powers of a mage have their uses, but it’s the most ancient of spells that command powers older and more powerful than the deities themselves that makes them truly terrifying.
